description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. The payer of a lost, low-priced parcel asks for a refund.

messages.subject: Where is my market basket?
messages.body: Hi, I ordered a market basket (KIK-1022) almost a month ago and it still hasn't come. The tracking hasn't moved in ages. Could you refund me please?
